classification: Post-study diagnostics using already observed 2024/2025; not new pristine OOS
execution_constraints: Use the previously selected 2025 H1/H2 parameters without re-selection.
Delay shifts entries by one complete 4h candle, represents a missed decision cycle, and re-sizes at actual entry using then-available ATR.
Exits use the existing frozen ATR/Donchian rules; no new exit parameter search.
Slippage remains an adverse cash-cost proxy. Market-order custom prices are not supported by Freqtrade; do not pretend limit-price hooks simulate market slippage.
Detail candles reduce intrabar ambiguity, but do not replay order books, queues or stop execution gaps.

risk_matching.target_rule: 0.8 * minimum 2024 annualized Mark-equity volatility of the three unscaled variants
risk_matching.scaling_rule: strategy risk fraction or hold allocation multiplied by target / training volatility; never exceed original exposure/risk settings
risk_matching.oos_rule: Freeze calibrated weights BEFORE running 2025; never scale from 2025 volatility or returns
risk_matching.interpretation: Ex-ante volatility budget matching, not identical tail/stop risk; disclose realized 2025 volatility mismatches. Hold reference is perpetual, not spot.

sealed_final_test: 2026 remains excluded from all scoring, execution tests and calibration

source_quality.detail_download: Freqtrade native Binance REST with exchange.only_from_ccxt=true; retain original archive dataset separately
source_quality.reason: Archive 15m has synthetic zero-volume bars and erroneous lows; replace fine data with independent native REST download before first test. Frozen parent main candles stay unchanged.
source_quality.treatment: Record REST 15m/hour and frozen parent aggregation discrepancies as qualified source warnings; do not invent prices or overwrite parent data. Reject any other unregistered discrepancy and all zero-volume futures bars.
